deride
verb [ T ]
  formal
uk
/dɪˈraɪd/ us
/dɪˈraɪd/
to laugh at or show no respect for someone or something, because you think they are stupid or of no value:
deride someone/something as something He derided my singing as pathetic.
This building, once derided by critics, is now a major tourist attraction.
